stemMd: Which pair of industries did the Schuman plan propose to place under common management?
explanationMd: The 1950 proposal focused on coal and steel. These industries were crucial to heavy industry and armaments, so shared management was intended to reduce the possibility of renewed conflict.

distractorRationale.b: These were not the plan's named industries.

distractorRationale.a: These were not its defining sectors.
distractorRationale.c: Financial services were not the proposed industrial pool.
